description: Envelope follower: it amplifies an audio signal, traces its envelope on a second jack and fires a trigger whenever that envelope passes a threshold

params.text: Sets how quickly the envelope follows the signal down, fast at the bottom of its travel and slow at the top, reading out in dB
Sets the level the envelope has to pass before the gate jack fires, reading out in dB
Sets the gain applied to the input before everything else, reading out in dB up to 6dB
Nothing in the module can move this switch: the maker configured no quantity for it, so it stays where it is and the gate jack always fires brief triggers rather than a held gate

inputs.text: The audio fed into the module

outputs.text: The input multiplied by the square of the gain knob
A 7ms 5V trigger each time the envelope rises past the threshold

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only
